llm_response.reason: foxloom.net shows multiple scam characteristics: (1) Unrealistic investment returns (10–35% monthly, 25% annual), (2) Offers 'free' exclusive signals, (3) Claims association with major companies (AMD, Yonex, Lamborghini, XM Global) and large managed assets ($3B, 'since 2009') despite a domain registered only in March 2025, (4) Heavy reliance on psychological tactics promising security, exclusivity, and guaranteed high profits, (5) No verifiable links to supposed partners, no credible company or regulatory information, (6) Fabricated adviser/testimonial sections, and (7) Typical patterns of Investment/Forex scam websites trying to attract deposits through false promises. All these make it a clear investment scam.
